title.zh: Bithumb 内部移动系统遭外部入侵并泄露个人数据，韩国监管机构调查
title.en: South Korea’s Second-Largest Crypto Exchange Bithumb Confirms Security Breach

current_state.zh: Bithumb disclosed a breach of its internal employee mobile system and is investigating whether member data was exposed, while notifying South Korean authorities and stating that the internal system is separate from its trading platform.
current_state.en: Bithumb disclosed a breach of its internal employee mobile system and is investigating whether member data was exposed, while notifying South Korean authorities and stating that the internal system is separate from its trading platform.

updates.title_zh: South Korea’s Second-Largest Crypto Exchange Bithumb Confirms Security Breach
updates.title_en: South Korea’s Second-Largest Crypto Exchange Bithumb Confirms Security Breach
updates.what_changed_zh: Bithumb confirmed that an unauthorized external party breached its internal mobile groupware system and leaked personal data, an incident discovered on October 27 that is now under investigation alongside cyber intrusions at Mirae Asset Global Investments and Daishin Securities, the latter exposing data on 38,490 customers, with South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service reviewing all three cases.
